ownerDecision: Core V0 WS3 historical research uses real observed OHLCV; known verified continuity-breaking events are excluded, corrected, or annotated where available; no affirmative no-event proof is required for research eligibility.
minimumResearchInput: sufficient observations for the requested technical calculation

continuitySemantics.CONTINUITY_PASS_BOUNDED: Research may proceed; state is preserved.
continuitySemantics.CONTINUITY_UNKNOWN: Research may proceed when minimum real-input requirements pass; UNKNOWN remains UNKNOWN.
continuitySemantics.CONTINUITY_FAIL: Research remains unavailable unless an existing verified event overlay supplies an explicit correction/annotation path; it is never converted to PASS.

eventOverlaySemantics.EXCLUDE: Exclude the affected research window/candidate and retain the verified event identity.
eventOverlaySemantics.CORRECT: Use existing upstream verified correction handling; this adapter does not rewrite OHLCV.
eventOverlaySemantics.ANNOTATE: Allow research with the verified event annotation attached to the research evidence.
eventOverlaySemantics.NO_KNOWN_VERIFIED_BREAKING_EVENT: Research may proceed; this is not a claim that no event occurred.

ma60Boundary.formalWs2Method: MA60Evidence.is_formal_consumable remains unchanged and requires CONTINUITY_PASS_BOUNDED plus FORMAL_AVAILABLE.
ma60Boundary.researchMethod: MA60Evidence.is_research_consumable is an additive WS3-only method; it preserves period, as-of, raw basis, observation count, value, and lineage requirements, and permits CONTINUITY_UNKNOWN with RESEARCH_AVAILABLE.

implementation.researchModeOptIn: CandidatePanelInput.research_eligibility must be explicitly supplied; absent context retains the old formal-only behavior.

stateExamples.input: real OHLCV + valid identity/lineage + sufficient observations + UNKNOWN + no verified event
